title: Signature animation

location.series: JKR / Burger King identity case study
location.extent: Complete clip; PNG is a poster frame

slide_intent: Connect symbol and wordmark through movement so viewers can recognize different forms as the same identity.
strategic_value: A repeating sequence from bun to logo to lettering can reinforce Burger King’s food-shaped signature.
demonstration: The clip assembles the burger logo, reduces it to the compact symbol, enlarges and repeats the wordmark, then returns to the logo.
practical_value: Compare how transformations preserve recognition between full and compact signatures.

content_islands.name: Assembly
content_islands.spec: Begin with the bun form on a cream field, then build the primary signature.

content_islands.name: Wordmark sequence
content_islands.spec: Move through the compact symbol into large scrolling and repeated wordmarks.

content_islands.name: Return
content_islands.spec: Resolve to the primary logo and back to a bun for the loop.

reference_purposes.Expression: The complete clip connects the bun-shaped symbol, compact mark and rounded wordmark through scale and repetition.
